Hello legal team —

Per Sara's note, attaching a redlined version of our master services agreement for review (redlined-master-agreement.pdf). Quick summary of the key changes we proposed to accelerate the pilot:

- Data handling: clarified retention boundaries for pilot data and added a short-term retention option (30 days) for dev logs.
- SLA: added pilot-level SLA of 99.5% with escalation path to dedicated support for production cutover.
- Liability: modestly narrowed caps during pilot period and preserved standard indemnities.
- Security: included SOC2 attestation clause and optional KMS integration note.

If it would help, Jonas (cc'd) can join a quick call to walk through the redlines line-by-line. Looking to keep the pilot start window in mid-March.

Thanks for taking a look — happy to adjust if there are procurement constraints.

Cheers,
